description: Canadian Climate Normals (1981-2010) from Environment Canada for a station: the long-run monthly average for an element, e.g. "January mean daily temperature at Winnipeg Richardson". Pass station (name, e.g. "WINNIPEG RICHARDSON") or climate_id (the 7-character normals station id, e.g. "5023222"), a month 1-12 (13 = whole year) and an element (mean_temperature, max_temperature, min_temperature, precipitation, rainfall, snowfall, snow_depth). Normals use their own station list: Toronto is climate_id "6158350"; a station that has no 1981-2010 normals returns count 0 with a hint. Keyless, official ECCC data.

climate_id.description: Climate identifier as used in the normals, e.g. "5023222" (Winnipeg Richardson), "6158350" (Toronto).

element.description: mean_temperature (default), max_temperature, min_temperature, precipitation, rainfall, snowfall, snow_depth.

month.description: Month 1-12, or 13 for the annual normal. Default: all months.

station.description: Station name (substring, upper-case in the source), e.g. "WINNIPEG RICHARDSON" or "TORONTO".

name: climate_normals
title: Climate Normals
